profile.headline: Software Engineer @ State Farm ®
profile.summary: Currently a Technology Intern at State Farm and studying at the University of Alabama at Birmingham pursuing a Bachelors degree in Computer Science with a minor in mathematics.

positions.title: Student Researcher
positions.description:
- Developing and designing a fitness mobile application as part of the HealthSmart UAB Grand Challenge.
- Involves designing, organizing, meeting, and working with a team of mobile app developers

honors.title: Presidential Honors
honors.issuer: Issued by University of Alabama at Birmingham · Dec 2019

volunteerExperiences.description:
• Volunteering for the Audio/Video Technical Team for Dada Bhagwan Foundation, which has an audience base of more than 10 million worldwide. Annually traveled to event locations in major cities and countries (NYC, Chicago, LA, India, Atlanta, Houston, Brazil, Argentina, etc.) in order to setup a professional A/V system for live recording and webcasting. These events are broadcasted to over 25 TV channels across the world.
• Learned to work in a team under pressure during live recording using critical skills and problem solving knowledge.
• Played a significant role in vendor evaluation for high end audio and video equipment, along with determining the best venue locations and prices for our events.
• Confronted obstacles by making difficult and strategic decisions.

- StarTech Brainery is a socially responsible company founded by two university professors that emphasizes on developing problem solving, collaboration, and communication skills amongst the students as well as being engaged in real world voluntary projects focused on software development to develop entrepreneurial skills amongst them.
- Volunteered as a TA for teaching the basic fundamentals of Java
